log_file.description: Path to the log file for metadata agent.

log_dir.description: Directory where log files are stored.

workers.description: Number of worker processes for handling requests.

metadata_proxy_user.description: User name for metadata proxy process.

metadata_proxy_group.description: Group name for metadata proxy process.

metadata_proxy_bind_host.description: IP address or hostname for metadata proxy to bind to.

metadata_proxy_bind_port.description: Port for metadata proxy to listen on.

metadata_proxy_socket.description: Unix domain socket path for metadata proxy.

metadata_proxy_tcp_backlog.description: Maximum number of pending TCP connections for metadata proxy.

metadata_proxy_workers.description: Number of workers for metadata proxy.

metadata_proxy_shared_secret.description: Shared secret used to verify metadata proxy requests (required for security).

region_name.description: Region name used in Keystone authentication.

project_name.description: Project (tenant) name for the service user.

password.description: Password for metadata proxy authentication (should be set securely).

cafile.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for SSL verification (optional).

insecure.description: Disable SSL certificate verification (not recommended in production).

enable_isolated_metadata.description: Enable metadata service for isolated networks (e.g., without floating IPs).

use_namespace.description: Enable network namespaces for isolated metadata (required with L3 agent).

dns_servers.description: List of DNS servers for isolated metadata network.

isolated_metadata_hostname.description: Custom hostname for isolated metadata (fallback if not provided by DHCP).

isolated_metadata_ip.description: Custom IP for isolated metadata (fallback if not provided by DHCP).

metadata_network.description: Enable metadata network support on the proxy.

metadata_ip_version.description: IP version(s) for metadata (ipv4, ipv6, or both).

metadata_proxy_max_idle_time.description: Maximum idle time (seconds) for metadata proxy connections.

metadata_proxy_max_body_size.description: Maximum size (bytes) for metadata proxy request body.

metadata_proxy_max_concurrent_requests.description: Maximum concurrent metadata requests handled by proxy.

metadata_proxy_retries.description: Number of retries for failed metadata proxy requests.

metadata_proxy_ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required if SSL enabled).

metadata_proxy_ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (required if SSL enabled).

metadata_proxy_ssl_verify.description: Verify client SSL certificates (only if SSL enabled).

transport_url.description: Messaging transport URL (e.g., RabbitMQ or Redis).

redis_hosts.description: List of Redis hosts (format: host:port, comma-separated).

syslog_log_facility.description: Syslog facility for log messages (e.g., LOG_USER, LOG_DAEMON).

log_level.description: Logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

metadata_endpoints.description: List of custom service endpoint overrides.

endpoint_override.description: Full URL to override default service endpoint.
